scripts.dockerDev: npm run startDockerEngine && npm run build && docker build --platform linux/amd64 -t fieldworker.azurecr.io/fieldworkerapi5:dev . && echo 🔨✅ Dev build complete
scripts.dockerDevDeploy: npm run dockerDev && az acr login --name fieldworker && docker push fieldworker.azurecr.io/fieldworkerapi5:dev && az webapp restart --resource-group Fieldworker --name fieldworker4 && echo '🚀✅ Build deployed, (fieldworker4) service restarting'
scripts.dockerTest: npm run startDockerEngine && npm run build && docker build --platform linux/amd64 -t fieldworker.azurecr.io/fieldworkerapi5:test . && echo 🔨✅ Test build complete
scripts.dockerTestDeploy: npm run dockerTest && az acr login --name fieldworker && docker push fieldworker.azurecr.io/fieldworkerapi5:test && az webapp restart --resource-group Fieldworker --name fieldworkertestserver && echo '🚀✅ Build deployed, (fieldworkertest) service restarting'
scripts.dockerDevTestDeploy: npm run startDockerEngine && npm run build && docker build --platform linux/amd64 -t fieldworker.azurecr.io/fieldworkerapi5:dev -t fieldworker.azurecr.io/fieldworkerapi5:test . && az acr login --name fieldworker && docker push fieldworker.azurecr.io/fieldworkerapi5:dev && docker push fieldworker.azurecr.io/fieldworkerapi5:test && az webapp restart --resource-group Fieldworker --name fieldworker4 && az webapp restart --resource-group Fieldworker --name fieldworkertestserver && echo "🚀 Deployed to both dev (fieldworker4) and test (fieldworkertestserver)"
scripts.dockerProd: npm run startDockerEngine && npm run build && docker build --platform linux/amd64 -t fieldworker.azurecr.io/fieldworkerapi5:prod . && echo 🔨✅ Production build complete
